claim_process_signals.text: A pre-existing disease clause in your individual medical insurance plan refers to health conditions diagnosed before you bought the policy. These are important because there's a set waiting period before claims become active for these conditions. Stating them at the time of purchase works in your favour as transparency ensures quick claims.
